name: VoiceParameters
doc: Prepared voice controls. All values must be finite; linear gain is in [0,16].

fields.name: gain
fields.doc: Linear amplitude, normally source gain times distance/cone attenuation.

fields.name: rate
fields.doc: Playback rate, normally source pitch times Doppler.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Unit listener-local direction, with forward along negative Z.

fields.name: path
fields.doc: Worker-computed occlusion, transmission and reflection send.
